title: Yomelにログイン（キーボード表示・未入力）
description: Same empty-field state as login-space-id-empty, but with the field focused and the iOS system keyboard open. State-variant of the first screen, not a distinct step.

tapTargets.label: スペースID input field
tapTargets.guessedTarget: already focused; tapping again is a no-op

tapTargets.label: 次へ button (disabled)
tapTargets.guessedTarget: disabled; no-op until text is entered

tapTargets.label: 「スペースIDとは」link
tapTargets.guessedTarget: same as login-space-id-empty

tapTargets.label: keyboard 'return' key
tapTargets.guessedTarget: dismisses keyboard, likely returns to login-space-id-empty visual state

notes: The on-screen QWERTY keyboard is reproduced as simplified real HTML/CSS (not a screenshot), since the Figma dev-mode code for the keyboard is an extremely verbose per-key absolute-positioned layout (26+ nodes) that is pure iOS system chrome, not app UI — rebuilding it 1:1 would not add value for a click-through prototype per the brief's quality bar ('don't burn time pixel-chasing', priority on real tap targets over visual polish). Individual letter keys have no data-tap (not meaningful navigation); only the 'return' key does. The keyboard's own bottom bar visually covers the generic .home-indicator snippet (it is still included per the output contract, just underneath, z-index 60 keyboard on top).

description: Same filled field ('ernie') and enabled 次へ button as login-space-id-filled, but no keyboard and a floating black toast reading 「スペースIDが存在しません」(this space ID does not exist). This is the failure-path result of submitting login-space-id-filled.

tapTargets.label: スペースID input field
tapTargets.guessedTarget: re-focuses to edit/retry — would likely bring the keyboard back

tapTargets.label: clear (x) icon inside field
tapTargets.guessedTarget: clears the field, same as login-space-id-filled

tapTargets.label: 次へ button (enabled)
tapTargets.guessedTarget: retries verification with the current (or edited) space ID

tapTargets.label: 「スペースIDとは」link
tapTargets.guessedTarget: same as other space-ID screens

notes: AMBIGUITY WORTH FLAGGING: this error screen shows the exact same input value 'ernie' that login-space-confirm later treats as a *valid, confirmed* space ID leading straight to login. That is logically inconsistent (same ID shown as both nonexistent and valid) — most likely the Figma mockup just reused the 'ernie' placeholder value across states without updating it for the error variant, rather than this being an intentional product detail. Didn't invent a different error value since the brief says not to invent content; flagging instead. New asset downloaded: assets/toast-error-icon.svg (white x-in-circle icon inside the toast, hash d1ec63e0...).

This is reached after a *valid* space ID is confirmed (contrast with login-space-id-error, see its notes).
